messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — multiple CUDA OOMs observed on decode-node-pool-3 while handling streaming decode. Auto-pager triggered. Symptoms: sudden memory growth during streaming decode, nodes hitting GPU OOM and container restarts.

oncall-bot: Severity: P1. Affected cluster: eu-west-1 decode-node-pool-3. Metric spike started ~3412345660.

sophia_runtime: saw this in traces — long-running streaming sessions with no max_tokens enforcement for a subset of requests. looks like some SDK clients are sending empty max_tokens and our routing layer treated empty as unlimited.

amar_infra: confirmed node restarts 3x in last 6m, GPU mem usage climbs until CUDA OOM then container restart. Node 3,4,7 affected.

devon_oncall: paging infra now. @sophia_runtime can you confirm whether this is a config drift or a real request-level bug?

sophia_runtime: quick root cause hypothesis: request header `X-Client-Max-Tokens` is not propagated through the streaming proxy for gRPC->HTTP conversion for a handful of legacy SDK paths. routing falls back to model default which for this model is effectively "no hard cap" (we rely on client max_tokens to bound). that allowed runaway generation.

emma_support: we're getting customer reports — tickets referencing partial responses and "server error" during long chats. escalations from two top-tier customers (acct-A, acct-B).

ops-bot: Deploy started: rollback-proxy-hotfix #r345 to enforce `max_tokens` default=1024 on proxy (canary to 2 nodes).

amar_infra: canary applied to nodes 3 & 4. routing now injects default max_tokens=1024 when header missing. monitoring at +1m.

sophia_runtime: also pushing a runtime safeguard: enforce per-request decode token ceiling in the decoder loop (`decoder_max_tokens_ceiling=4096`) to prevent runaway if proxy misses header. will hotpatch as config change first.

devon_oncall: applying temporary traffic shed — reducing streaming concurrency on pool-3 by 40% to prevent cascading OOMs. added a soft throttle at LB.

ops-bot: Canary metrics: GPU OOM count on node-3 dropped to 0 in last 3m. overall OOM spike falling.

emma_support: notifying acct-A and acct-B: temporary degraded availability for long-lived streams; most short requests unaffected. offering post-incident follow-up.

sophia_runtime: logs (snippet):

```
2026-03-15T10:47:21Z ERROR [decoder] CUDA out of memory: attempted 6.5GiB allocate on 8GiB device
request_id=xyz123 client_hdrs={} X-Client-Max-Tokens=
stack: ... decoder_loop() ...
```

sophia_runtime: note the empty header value. thats what bypassed our previous guard.

amar_infra: node-7 still flapping but not OOMing — container restarts stabilized after throttle. I'm cordoning node-7 for deeper inspection, migrating pods off.

devon_oncall: oncall handover coming in 30m, adding @amar_infra to next oncall shift notes.

lee_ml: are there any perf regressions from injecting default max_tokens? we should watch latency for short-chat workloads.

sophia_runtime: minimal — default 1024 only used when header missing (rare). We do need an eval to measure token distribution and update default down if needed.

ops-bot: Hotpatch apply: runtime config `decoder_max_tokens_ceiling=4096` rolled to pool-3.

emma_support: customers informed: acct-A saw ~22% of their streaming requests fail intermittently; acct-B ~8%. no data exfiltration. both asked for a root-cause note and ETA for fix.

devon_oncall: current status: mitigations in place — proxy default injection, runtime ceiling, throttle. OOM rate down 95% from peak. Continuing monitoring.

oncall-bot: ACTIONS: 1) infra to cordon+inspect node-7 (amar_infra). 2) Runtime to create a permanent guard and add unit test for header handling (sophia_runtime). 3) Support to send RCA to acct-A/B and open SLO credit request doc (emma_support). 4) Platform to run audit for other legacy SDK paths (lee_ml).

amar_infra: cordoned node-7, collecting logs and core dump. opening ticket INFRA-3421 with attachments.

sophia_runtime: pushing PR to enforce header parsing in proxy + add test harness for gRPC->HTTP translation paths. PR link: https://ghe.redwood/pr/6678

emma_support: drafted customer note, will send once we have confirmed RCA steps.

devon_oncall: handing off to night oncall in 25m — @amar_infra you're on deck for escalation, @sophia_runtime for runtime follow-ups. I'll summarize in PagerDuty.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED — severity remains P1 until next verification window closes (2h).

ops-bot: Post-mitigation check: 60m after canary, no new OOM restarts on pool-3.

sophia_runtime: Postmortem TODOs: add header validation at gateway, patch SDKs to set explicit max_tokens, add metric for "requests missing max_tokens", update docs.

emma_support: I'll send immediate customer communications and schedule a follow-up call with acct-A.

devon_oncall: closing real-time coordination. leaving thread open for postmortem notes. thanks team :thumbsup:
